acquisition_method.evidence: All experiments were done in DDA mode with top 15 ions isolated at a window of 1.2 m/z and default charge state of +

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The sample was cooled to room temperature (RT) and iodoacetamide (Sigma) was added at a final concentration of 40 mM and incubated for 15 min in the dark at RT.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The sample was cooled to room temperature (RT) and iodoacetamide (Sigma) was added at a final concentration of 40 mM and incubated for 15 min in the dark at RT.

cleavage_agent.evidence: sequencing-grade trypsin was added to a final amount of 1:50 (trypsin:total protein, w:w) for plasma and urine; and 1:20 (trypsin:total protein, w:w) for fibroblast lysates.

collision_energy.evidence: Stepped collision energy was applied to fragment precursors at normalized collision energies of 15, 25, and 40.

enrichment_method.value: filtration with 10 kDa molecular weight cutoff filters (MWCO)
enrichment_method.evidence: The trypsin-digested samples were divided equally to be enriched with two different strategies, namely filtration with 10 kDa molecular weight cutoff filters (MWCO) and strong anion exchange chromatography (SAX).

fragmentation_method.evidence: All samples were analyzed by LC–MS/MS in HCD fragmentation mode as well as EtHCD mode with runs being 150 or 155 min at a flow rate of 300 nl/min.

instrument.evidence: The dried peptides were reconstituted in 0.1% formic acid and were analyzed on an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer connected online to Dionex RSLC3000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Ionization of eluting peptides was performed using an EASY-Spray source kept at an electric potential of 2.2 kV.
